title: UrduBERT: Multilingual Transformer for Regional Dialects
description: A high-performance BERT-based foundation model fine-tuned on 40M+ tokens of Urdu corpus across news media, public discourse, and classical literature, achieving state-of-the-art results on Urdu NLP benchmarks.

title: RoboSight: Real-Time Edge Vision for Autonomous Aerial Drones
description: Lightweight custom YOLOv8 backbone quantized with TensorRT and deployed directly onto Jetson Orin Nano hardware for sub-20ms aerial reconnaissance and obstacle avoidance.

title: MedScan AI: Multi-Class Chest X-Ray Pathology Localization
description: Self-supervised deep neural model trained to recognize 14 thoracic abnormalities in low-dose chest radiographs, validated across hospital clinics with radiologist-level ROC-AUC.

title: SmartGrid AI: Predictive Dispatch & Load Shedding Forecasting
description: Spatio-temporal LSTM and Transformer ensemble trained on regional sub-station telemetries to predict peak industrial electricity demand with sub-3.1% MAPE error.

title: Automated Cross-Lingual Plagiarism Engine for Urdu Documents
description: Semantic multilingual embedding pipeline developed as a capstone FYDP to catch syntactic obfuscation and paraphrasing across academic Urdu research corpora.

title: Real-Time Pakistani Sign Language Gesture Synthesizer
description: Vision-based landmark extractor and LSTM gesture classifier converting regional sign language gestures to real-time speech synthesis at 30 FPS.

title: Generative Autonomous Traffic Scene Simulator for South Asian Roads
description: Diffusion model-driven synthetic scene generator synthesizing unstructured, high-density traffic scenes and erratic vehicle movement for autonomous perception validation.
